about: The foliage check's kinds (foliage.ts, D368): for each card the world's plants wear, the atlas it is in (its .ron), what it is (spray, needles, single or flowers), the plants that wear it, and how wide its card is grown near the camera, the largest of them, in metres: about 1.1 times the spray it is laid round (`clump_cards`), as the code that grows it says. `known` lists each card's failures already known, with why; `*` is every card's.

oak.grows: the world's oaks (flora.ron Oak); the lush forest's oak scrub and oak saplings
oak.from: flora.ron Oak's clump_m 2.6; the lush scrub's sprays 0.6, saplings' 0.7 (thicket.rs)

pine.grows: the world's generic pine (flora.ron Pine), where the woods are given no conifers of their own (D366); the mountain lake's pines before D366

hazel.grows: the world's bushes (flora.ron Bush); the lush forest's hazel stools, coppice and hazel saplings

berry.grows: the world's berry bushes and dwarf shrubs (flora.ron); the lush forest's bilberry
berry.from: plants::bush: clumps 0.35 to 0.5 of a bush up to 1.5 m

fern.grows: ferns (flora.ron Fern); the lush forest's bracken and fronds
fern.from: a frond about a metre long (floor.rs, flora.ron)

herb.from: a herb a third of a metre across (floor.rs)

oakbranch.from: an old oak's sprays 1.45 (species.rs), its leaves 14 cm (D276)

spruce.grows: the lush forest's spruces and young spruce
spruce.from: a spruce's sprays to 0.8 (species.rs), young spruce 0.5 (floor.rs)

rush.grows: rushes and reeds at the water's edge (flora.ron Rush, Reed)
rush.from: a tuft about a metre tall, its cards upright (plants::tuft)

ivy.from: leaves a hand across or less (D359)

ivydark.from: leaves a hand across or less (D359)

*.thickness: no atlas has a thickness map: the shader lights a leaf through by its colour alone (foliage_fragment.wesl, lit_through), the same through blade, vein and twig (D291's 'lit through from behind', the review of D292: 'still short in light through each leaf')

oak.sharpness: the world's oaks (flora.ron Oak, clump_m 2.6) grow its card 2.9 m across, a leaf 0.4 m long, four times a real one's; the lush forest's scrub and saplings grow it at 0.7 m, sharp

birch.relief: a picture (birchgold), its normal map flat
birch.tilts: a picture, its normal map flat
birch.leafLight: a picture's leaves all one tone of gold
birch.gamut: autumn gold by design, not a summer green

pine.relief: a picture, its normal map flat: the generic pine lit as flat cards, as the mountain lake's were before D366
pine.sharpness: the world's pine (flora.ron Pine, clump_m 2.4) grows its card 2.6 m across, magnified 1.3 times at 2 m

herb.relief: a picture, its normal map flat
